admin_only.description: Only run automatic review and management commands for AstrBot administrators.

review_every_turns.description: Run review after this many completed Agent turns per session.

review_provider_id.description: Optional provider ID for background reviews. Leave empty to use the current session provider.

max_concurrent_reviews.description: Maximum background reviews running at the same time.

review_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for one background review LLM call.

auto_sync_sandbox.description: Best-effort sync generated skills to active sandboxes after writes.
